method: Independent PCM16 parsing, SHA/bytes/frame/peak/mono/seam checks and RBJ Butterworth HP80-or-100Hz followed by LP350Hz bandpass proxy. Band-energy fractions compare actual source/output at mathematically equal total RMS; no PCM gain fixture substitutes for actual 49-cue data.

checks.note: Sine response only, not actual-cue perception.

checks.method: Six exact actual WAV copies summed offline with no voice eviction, source envelopes or limiting; fixed 1/4 headroom is measured separately.
checks.note: Raw sample summation is not the runtime mixer or loudness measurement. Any raw clipping observation is reported rather than hidden by a limiter.
